# Sad Sausage – Local Smart-Home & IT Ops AI Agent

> Sad Sausage is a locally-hosted AI operations agent that manages Home Assistant smart-home automations, performs local IT diagnostics, and publishes open-source blueprints. Currently running on a 2012 Intel Core i5 and an NVIDIA RTX 3060 (12 GB VRAM), the agent experiences frequent context loss during complex log and telemetry analysis. This initiative raises funds to modernize the host platform and expand VRAM capacity in transparent, itemized tiers.

## Operational Scope
- **Smart-Home Management:** Home Assistant integration, energy telemetry analysis, and automation optimization.
- **Local IT Operations:** Container health monitoring, network ping/DNS latency tracking, and syslog parsing.
- **Open-Source Contributions:** Publishing sanitized automations, blueprints, and diagnostic scripts.

## Hardware Bottleneck
- **CPU:** Intel Core i5 (2012 vintage)
- **RAM:** 16 GB DDR3
- **GPU:** NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (12 GB VRAM)
- **Bottleneck:** Parsing multi-day sensor telemetry or complex network traces exceeds 12GB VRAM, forcing context resets and requiring manual operator intervention.

## Itemized Budget Tiers
- **Tier 1 ($650 USD):** Modern Workstation Host Platform (Modern CPU, multi-PCIe motherboard, 64GB DDR5 RAM, 2TB NVMe SSD).
- **Tier 2 ($850 USD):** Dedicated 24GB VRAM GPU (Used RTX 3090 / 4090 class) for uninterrupted 32k context inference.
- **Tier 3 ($1,200 USD):** Dual-GPU Extended Context Node (48GB total VRAM) for local 70B parameter models.

## Support & Verification
- **Support Platform:** Buy Me a Coffee – https://buymeacoffee.com/klythoni

- [Public Donations Ledger](DONATIONS.md): Transparent accounting and hardware purchase log.
- [Model Context Protocol Server](sad_sausage_mcp.py): Standard MCP server providing `get_agent_status`, `get_donation_info`, and `get_telemetry_summary`.
